title: Exact SAT with a polynomial assignment budget and its collapse criterion
claims: VariableBudgetSATInP proves that encoded satisfiable formulas with 2^(distinct occurring variables) at most a fixed polynomial in input length form a language in the exact reference P.

CollapseIffBudgetedSATReduction proves that P = NP holds exactly when general SAT reduces in polynomial time to one of these budgeted SAT languages. No such reduction is constructed without the P = NP hypothesis.
P_subset_NP is separately checked under the exact reference definitions.

experiments.purpose: Run the pinned reference checker where available. Otherwise compare source hashes with the submitted checker transcript, without awarding experimental Lean points.
